policy: Read-only spatial soil ROI comparison; candidate sampling, tree fit and raw local row frame held fixed within each pair. Narrow candidates are subsets of the preceding wider-ground input candidates. No registration, mesh, IMU bias correction, or output rotation.
limitations: Trunk/support row is inferred, not manually surveyed. Narrow soil planes remain sensitive to grass and surface roughness.
Single-view tree-plane visibility bias is unchanged; this does not establish a structural V centre.
Canopy-only row fallbacks are not used to claim an under-trunk soil strip.
Width sensitivity is diagnostic, not a formal confidence interval.
